tasks.title: Model the custom field document
tasks.description: server/src/models/customFieldModel.ts: immutable slug key, eight types, options with colours, projects, required, order, archived, the caps and the unique (workspace, key) index.

tasks.title: Write the custom value rules
tasks.description: server/src/utils/customFields.ts: fieldPath/fieldAppliesTo, coerceFieldValue per type, planCustomValues (merge, required on create, archived fields), describeCustomChanges and slugFromName/newOptionId.

tasks.title: Load the field definitions for a request
tasks.description: server/src/utils/customFieldsDb.ts: loadFieldDefs in display order and planRequestCustom with the workspace's member ids.

tasks.title: Write the workflow stage rules
tasks.description: server/src/utils/workflow.ts: defaultWorkflow, validateWorkflow (1-12, keys, names, groups, colours, limits), firstStageOf, stageFor, workflowOf with the legacy board limits and planStageMoves.

tasks.title: Store the stages and the task-side fields
tasks.description: server/src/models/workspaceModel.ts (workflow.stages next to boardSettings.wipLimits) and server/src/models/taskModel.ts (stage key and the custom map).

tasks.title: Declare the field router and its permissions
tasks.description: server/src/routes/fieldRoutes.ts mounted at /api/workspaces/:slug/fields with tasks:read for the list and settings:manage for every change, /order declared before /:id.

tasks.title: List and create fields
tasks.description: listFields in display order and createField with the slug key, the 30-active-field cap, option validation, projects, required and the appended order plus the field.created audit entry.

tasks.title: Update a field and clear the removed options
tasks.description: updateField: name, options (id kept for renames/recolours, missing ones removed), projects, required, archived with the cap on unarchiving; clearRemovedOptions unsets or pulls the lost choices from the tasks.

tasks.title: Reorder and delete fields
tasks.description: reorderFields (listed ids first, unknown id refused, the rest keep their relative order) and deleteField (unset the values on every task and audit the count).

tasks.title: Validate custom values on task writes
tasks.description: taskController create/update call planRequestCustom for the custom part, apply the merge, describe the changes as custom.<key> and reject unknown or archived keys and missing required fields.

tasks.title: Filter the task list by custom values
tasks.description: taskQuery.parseCustomFilters/buildTaskFilter: at most five cf.<key> parameters with slug keys, "none" for no value, and numeric/boolean text comparison.

tasks.title: Serve and replace the workflow stages
tasks.description: workflowController.getWorkflow and updateWorkflow: validation, moves for removed stages, status and completedAt resynchronisation, stale-stage reset, legacy board limits cleared and the workflow.updated audit diff.

tasks.title: Keep stage and status in sync on task writes
tasks.description: stageFor applied by createTask and updateTask, the "Unknown stage" rejection, and the resolveStage fallback used when a task's stage does not match its status.

tasks.title: Build the fields feature module
tasks.description: features/fields: types, api, lib/fields.ts and lib/fieldFilters.ts mirrors, and the per-workspace cache (useCustomFields) shared by every view.

tasks.title: Show custom fields on tasks
tasks.description: CustomFieldInput, CustomFieldValue, TaskCustomFields, TaskFormCustomFields and TaskCustomChips plus the list column per active field (listColumns.customColumns/sortByColumn).

tasks.title: Add the custom field filters to the toolbar
tasks.description: fieldFilters.filterableFields/filterOptions/withCustomFilter wired into the filters that live in the URL, matching values with lib/filters.matchesCustom.

tasks.title: Build the workflow feature module
tasks.description: features/workflow: types, api, lib/stages.ts mirror, the per-workspace cache (useWorkflow plus cachedWorkflow) and the StageBadges/StageRow/BoardPreview/DeleteStageDialog components.

tasks.title: Build the settings pages
tasks.description: CustomFieldsPage (list, create/edit, reorder, archive, delete with a warning) and WorkflowSettingsPage (staged stage list with a preview, limits, save through useWorkflow), both behind settings:manage.

tasks.title: Unit test the rules on both sides
tasks.description: server/src/__tests__/customFields.test.ts and workflow.test.ts against client/src/features/fields/__tests__/fields.test.ts, fieldFilters.test.ts and client/src/features/workflow/__tests__/stages.test.ts (CON-202, CON-404).

tasks.title: Integration test the definitions end to end
tasks.description: server/src/__integration__/customFields.test.ts and workflow.test.ts against a real MongoDB: create/update/reorder/delete a field, clear removed options, replace the workflow and check the moved tasks.

tasks.title: Test the client surfaces
tasks.description: fieldsUi.test.tsx (values, editors, read-only, settings page), workflowBoard.test.tsx (stage columns, WIP badge, moves with stage), WorkflowSettingsPage.test.tsx, customFilters.test.ts and listColumns.test.ts.

tasks.title: Pass the repository quality gates
tasks.description: pnpm --filter server typecheck && pnpm --filter server test; pnpm --filter client typecheck && pnpm --filter client test && pnpm --filter client lint; pnpm --filter client build (constitution CON-402).
